language.syntax: /language <code> | /language set <code> | /language list | /language reload | /language stats | /language info | /language template <code> | /language exportmissing | /language clearmissing | /language validate <code> | /language regenerate <code> | /language override set <key> <value> | /language override get <key> | /language override remove <key> | /language override list | /language override clear | /language override reload
language.notes: The root requires vanilla OP 4 (`source.hasPermission(4)`), not the neoessentials.language node. The permission registry records the command as vanilla:op-level-4. Bare `/language <code>` is shorthand for set. The <value> of override set is a greedyString (the rest of the line). The console passes the OP check.

examples.title: Switch the server to Russian
examples.goal: The language is set by a single code; players do not need to install anything.
examples.result: `list` prints the codes from the jar. `/language ru_ru` is the same as `/language set ru_ru` and writes `localization.language` to the config. `stats` shows how many keys are covered relative to en_us. An unknown code does not break chat: missing strings are taken from en_us.

examples.title: Fix one string without touching the jar
examples.goal: Your own wording for a kit or ban message that survives a mod update.
commands: /language override set commands.neoessentials.kits.claimed You received kit {0}
examples.result: The override is stored in the DataStore (`language_overrides`), not in a language file. `get` prints the current override or says the key has none. Double any `'` quote in a value with `{0}`, otherwise MessageFormat swallows the substitution.

examples.title: Your own full translation
examples.goal: Start a file in languages/custom/ instead of copying from the jar by hand.
examples.result: `template` writes a skeleton into `languages/custom/`. It is an overlay: keys missing from the file are still taken from the jar. `validate` checks placeholders and §-codes. After editing the file by hand, run `reload`, not a restart.

edgeCases.title: OP 4 and neoessentials.language are different things
edgeCases.body: Brigadier checks `hasPermission(4)`. No PermissionRegistry node is attached to this command. A player with `neoessentials.language` in LuckPerms but without OP 4 will not see the command.
edgeCases.fix: Either grant OP 4 / use the console, or accept that an external provider cannot open this command by node.

edgeCases.title: reload does not re-register commands
edgeCases.body: `/language reload` re-reads catalogues and overrides. The `commands.language` section is read at startup: a disabled command will not appear after reload.
edgeCases.fix: Enabling `/language` itself needs a server restart.

knownIssues.title: A single quote in a string with {0} prints a literal {0}
knownIssues.body: This is MessageFormat: `'` starts an escaped section and swallows the placeholder. en_us/ru_ru already account for this by doubling; your own override is easy to break.
knownIssues.fix: Write `''` instead of `'`. After the edit, run `/language override reload` or `/language reload`.
